findings.claim: Filter state has correct issue-time variance index
findings.reason: Last fitted variance corresponds to final refit increment; the recorded residual at that increment drives the next variance step. Each subsequent observed increment advances variance before replacing its residual; one further step gives the next simulated-increment variance.

findings.claim: POT historical denominator aligns with first future increment of each mature label
findings.reason: Headroom origins start at segment indexzero; first increment variance is historical_v[0], and the first W such variances align with W headroom origins. Parameters are in-sample at refit, not historical forecasts at those starts.

findings.claim: FHS retains finite empirical pool without hidden moment correction
findings.reason: Stored standardized residuals pass directly to rng.choice; their empirical moments need not be zero/unit. No empirical financial moments calculated or pool changed.

findings.claim: QRF mature labels and transforms use only the scheduled completed pool
findings.reason: Observed source is sliced at latest issue, label ends are explicitly checked against refit, transforms and G/a use that pool. Future entries may exist in batch caches but no future label index is selected.

findings.claim: Same-target reports include known floor and signed simulation anchor
findings.reason: FHS simulates native increments from signed current position including zero step; POT/QRF restore nonnegative headroom above absolute observed issue position.
